verdict.rationale: IP allowlisting is a fair axis for a self-hosted Git service, but the evidence pack never documents restricting organization or repository access by source IP. The only related items are generic 'user permission management, access control lists' and a user's own SSH port-forwarding workaround. Both are adjacent controls or user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can restrict access to organization code to an IP allowlist
